factory_credit.note: Factory does not publish a USD value for one Factory Standard Credit (pricing page, plan pages, models page and Analytics API reference checked 2026-10-22). Droid cost_usd therefore stays 0 and factory_credits are reported per model. Measured: credits ~= input tokens x model multiplier (glm-5.3-flash 7314 tok -> 465 credits; gpt-6-sol 8336 tok -> 6689 credits). gpt-6-luna (81 credits / 1550 tok) and gpt-6.1-sol (2981 credits / 2961 tok) multipliers measured from one probe each on 2026-10-25. claude/ models are priced at Anthropic list price (prices_per_million), so a run's cost mixes USD and Factory credits.

prices_source: Anthropic list prices per million tokens (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, as quoted by several Oct 2026 pricing summaries; checked 2026-10-22). Haiku 5.5 rate is for prompts up to 100K tokens. Cache writes are billed here at the plain input rate. Calls run on the Claude subscription via claude -p; cost_usd is the list-price equivalent, not the bill.
